title: Milk and Cookies with Jana Schirmer & Johannes Voss

paragraphs.text: T his time on Milk & Cookies we have a special treat: not one Magic artist, but TWO. Today we're joined by the fabulous Deutschland Duo, Jana Schirmer & Johannes Voss.

Jana and Johannes are fairly new to Magic , with just five cards in released sets, but they've done another seventeen in upcoming ones (including the just-announced New Phyrexia ). They work as a team, much like Batman and Robin... except they both get to be Batman, because both have great talents (I don't want to start a fight between them about who gets to be Batman, either).
Now, with the brief introduction out of the way, let's start the interrogation, shall we?
How long have you two been working together?
What got you interested in illustration and fantasy art?
How long have you been working as fantasy artists?
So Johannes, does this mean Jana is Batman and you are Robin? (OK, I shouldn't have said that—now you'll argue).
How long have you been illustrating Magic cards?
What was your first Magic illustration?
Was it tough "breaking in" to Magic?
Ah yes, Jon Schindehette, my old bodyguard. Sounds like he saw your potential right out of the gates. That must have been exciting!
What is your favorite piece you've done for Magic?
There's nothing quite like illustrating the big nasty ones, huh?

That brings this episode of Milk and Cookies to a close. I'd like to send a big thanks out to Jana and Johannes for letting us peek behind the scenes, and I would also like to thank Jeremy and Jon for letting me tease them constantly... I'd also like to thank Batman, but he won't return my calls or bat signals.
I hope you all enjoyed it!
